'''Servo slippers''' also known as '''Servo braces''' or '''Repulsorlift assisted braces''' were joint, foot, leg, hand, and arm braces developed by [[Mahled Medical Services]] which used a combination of muscle stimulators, [[Repulsorlift/Legends|repulsor]] compensators, and movement servos to provide precise movement under high gravity conditions. However, the braces also served as a medical device in normal gravity worlds, by restoring those with impaired motor skills with ease of movement.
